# Encryptoverse

> Independent, read-only crypto market dashboard. Live prices, market cap, volume, price history, the Fear & Greed index, DeFi totals and news for the top 50 cryptocurrencies. Every figure names its data source; there are no paid placements and no accounts.

## Pages
- [Live crypto prices](https://encryptoverse.com/): top-50 coins by market cap
- [ICOs & token sales](https://encryptoverse.com/token-sales): where public sales happen, documented past sales, due-diligence checklist
- [Trending](https://encryptoverse.com/trending): 24h gainers, losers and most traded
- [DeFi](https://encryptoverse.com/defi): TVL by chain, stablecoin supply, governance votes, new DEX pools
- [News](https://encryptoverse.com/news): headlines linked to the original publishers
- [Converter](https://encryptoverse.com/converter): crypto and fiat conversion

## Trust
- [Methodology & data sources](https://encryptoverse.com/methodology): where each number comes from, refresh rates and limitations
- [About](https://encryptoverse.com/about)
- [Risk disclosure](https://encryptoverse.com/risk-disclosure)
- [Sitemap](https://encryptoverse.com/sitemap.xml): includes one page per top-50 coin at /coin/<id>

Information only, not financial advice. Source code: https://github.com/Leeshwaan04/encryptoverse
